metadata.title: The Zui Diagnostic Contract
metadata.note: Every diagnostic a conforming Zui implementation may raise, bound to the constitutional rule it enforces. Prose explaining these entries is in doc/language/VIOLATIONS.md; this file is the contract implementations load. Diagnostic ids are stable forever -- like rule numbers, a retired id is never reused.

1.name: Syntax
1.decides: the grammar parses; verbs, kinds and structure are well-formed

2.name: Local semantics
2.decides: everything decidable from a single declaration -- the honest target of a standalone verifier

3.name: Cross-pillar
3.requires: a symbol table of entities, actors, state and elements
3.decides: what the declaration cannot know about the system around it

4.name: Projection
4.decides: what only a painted page reveals; measured today by tools/ui-audit.html

diagnostics.summary: Selection has become execution: SATISFIES holds SELECT and ACT without CONFIRM.
A reading surface mutates: SATISFIES holds READ and ACT.
diagnostics.invariant: A read surface that silently acts is an intent violation.

diagnostics.summary: An act declares no way back: SATISFIES holds ACT, ALWAYS_REACHABLE lacks UNDO.
diagnostics.invariant: Every act has a reachable undo, or declares why it cannot.

diagnostics.summary: A flow that acts cannot be abandoned: ALWAYS_REACHABLE lacks CANCEL.
diagnostics.invariant: Pause, resume, and exit are always reachable; a trapped flow is unconstitutional.

diagnostics.summary: A multi-step flow has no reachable EXIT.
diagnostics.invariant: Pause, resume, and exit are always reachable; a trapped flow is unconstitutional.

diagnostics.summary: Motion or feedback that reports no state.
A declared element traces to no intent.
diagnostics.invariant: Every UI element must trace to at least one intent.

diagnostics.summary: The system holds state the operator must know, and no surface declares showing it.
diagnostics.invariant: An active filter is visible state.

diagnostics.summary: A consequential act names no actor.
Arriving content reserves no space and shoves the reading when it lands.
diagnostics.note: No fixture: undecidable from a declaration. Measured today by tools/ui-audit.html, which is the enforcement ladder working as designed.

diagnostics.summary: A verb in SATISFIES or ALWAYS_REACHABLE is not one of the 22.
diagnostics.invariant: The grammar is closed: a new medium adds renderings, never verbs.

diagnostics.summary: A .zui declaration kind outside the ten this language defines (WIDGET, USER).
diagnostics.note: Warning, not error: the reference implementation accepts these, and the difference should be visible rather than silent. See doc/language/README.md section 6.

diagnostics.summary: A field key appears more than once in one declaration.
Two declarations share a kind and a name.
An INTENT_FLOW declares no intents.
PERSPECTIVE outside its enumeration.
TONE outside its enumeration.
An INTENT_FLOW reference names no declared flow.
A VIBE suppresses an intent another declaration guarantees as ALWAYS_REACHABLE.
A VISIBLE_ENTITIES name resolves to no entity in the model.
diagnostics.note: A known gap in the reference implementation: VISIBLE_ENTITIES is parsed and emitted to IR but never resolved. Raised with the reference implementation as decision-document 7.4.

diagnostics.summary: SURFACE_AS names a medium outside the ten this language defines.
diagnostics.note: The medium set is closed for the same reason the verb set is: a coverage matrix over media is only finite and checkable if the media are enumerated. The full enumeration and its capability matrix are data in conformance/media.json.

diagnostics.summary: A declaration satisfies an intent the declared medium cannot carry at all.
diagnostics.invariant: A new medium adds renderings, never verbs.
diagnostics.note: Print has no UNDO; a lamp has no READ. Only ABSENT raises -- media.json also records 'degraded' carriage (a parallel act becoming serial, a perception becoming a memory task) as data for tools, because a warning firing on every serial surface would be noise rather than law. Cites Rule 82, which became Perceivable State at constitution v3.9 and is what made 'the declared medium' a legal concept.

diagnostics.summary: A value in SIGNALS is not one of Rule 118's five semantic statuses.
diagnostics.invariant: The colours an interface uses to say something about a record split into exactly two families and no more.
diagnostics.note: Closed for the same reason the verbs and the media are closed: a vocabulary that anyone may extend cannot be checked, and a status palette with more values than an operator can keep apart is what Rule 118 forbids. NOT reconciled with TONE, and deliberately so -- TONE is the register the system speaks in (the MESSAGE stratum), SIGNALS is what a value means about a record (the SIGNAL stratum). Each enumeration refuses the other's words, which is correct for two strata and is why both are documented pointing at each other.

diagnostics.summary: An expression field is declared on a declaration that satisfies no intent.
diagnostics.invariant: Every expression declaration traces to an intent, or it is an error.
diagnostics.note: INTENT_ORPHAN one level down, and the rule that keeps the inversion intact: expression is intent's refinement, never a second language beside it. A declaration saying how something should be PERCEIVED without saying what the operator is DOING has inverted the model this language exists to enforce. SIGNALS is the first expression field; ROLE, MOTION, MESSAGE and TEMPO raise the same diagnostic as their grammars land, which is why this id names the stratum family rather than the field.

diagnostics.summary: Every semantic status a surface declares renders as absence in the medium it declared.
diagnostics.invariant: If the system knows something important, the operator must be able to perceive it -- in the medium the surface declares.
diagnostics.note: Declaring muted on a silent channel is not the defect: silence is the CORRECT rendering of 'waiting, inactive', and a sound announcing inactivity is a contradiction. The defect is narrower and needs both axes -- when EVERY value a surface declares renders as absence, the surface promised a perceptible status and rendered nothing at all. The first check that needs the medium enumeration and the signal vocabulary together, which is what the medium axis was closed for. Stated over 'every declared value renders as absence' rather than over muted by name, so the next channel's data does not require a rewrite. Which values a medium renders as absence is data in signal.json, listed only for channels with a shipped renderer -- a medium absent from that table is UNDECIDED and raises nothing.
